risks.risk: Model mismatch (DGX 520 vs another Yamaha portable) which changes value and parts compatibility.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (usually on the underside or back panel) and a close-up of the front panel model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Yamaha portable keyboard (worst case: not confirmed DGX 520).

risks.risk: Hidden key faults (dead keys) or intermittent contacts not visible in a still photo.
risks.proof: Short video: press every key across the full range and show the display responding (or record audio of a scale with no dropouts).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully guaranteed (worst case: assume possible dead key until tested).

risks.risk: No crackle/noise claim may be false due to speaker/line-out issues or worn volume/panel controls.
risks.proof: Audio clip: play a few notes at low and high volume, plus a quick test of headphone/line-out if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible audio/control noise (worst case: treat as needing service).

risks.risk: Adapter may be missing or wrong voltage/amperage, causing power issues.
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter label (voltage/current) and a video showing the keyboard powering on with it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not included / not confirmed (worst case: buyer must source correct adapter).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: cracked casing, missing knobs, damaged ports, or battery compartment corrosion.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of: ports (DC in), headphone/USB/MIDI if present, underside, and any visible damage.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest condition tier until physical condition is confirmed.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the underside/back label showing exact model (DGX 520) and serial number.
Video test: play a full-range scale (all keys) and show the display responding; include a quick button/feature check.
Audio test at low and high volume to confirm 'no crackle' (and headphone/line-out if available).
Photo of the adapter label (voltage/current) plus a video showing the keyboard powering on with that adapter.
response.reason: The photo shows a Yamaha portable keyboard, but the exact DGX 520 model and working condition (keys/buttons/audio) and adapter inclusion are not verifiable from the single image.
